description: The export's processing and encoders (src/export/encode.h, padding.h, png_writer.h, exr_writer.h; decisions 089, 090, 103 and 126): Painter's PNG and OpenEXR files re-encoded byte for byte, the recorded processing written by WriteExport and applied to Painter's own values byte-identical to Painter's files, and the processing not fitted yet.

entries.subject: PNG files: chunks, row filters and compression of Painter's PNG export
entries.formula: Signature; IHDR (8 or 16 bits; grey, grey and alpha, RGB or RGBA; not interlaced); pHYs 2835 x 2835 per metre; IDAT chunks of 8192 bytes (the last shorter) holding one zlib stream (level 6, window bits 15, memory level 8) of the filtered rows; IEND. Each row takes the filter whose bytes have the smallest sum of min(b, 256 - b), ties to the earlier; the row above the first is zero. 8-bit grey chooses among all five filters and compresses with Z_DEFAULT_STRATEGY; every other layout chooses among None, Sub and Paeth and compresses with Z_FILTERED (src/export/png_writer.h, decisions 089 and 103).

entries.subject: OpenEXR files: header, channels and PIZ compression of Painter's OpenEXR export
entries.formula: Single-part scanline file, version 2; attributes channels, compression (PIZ), dataWindow, displayWindow, lineOrder (increasing y), pixelAspectRatio 1, screenWindowCenter (0, 0), screenWindowWidth 1; FLOAT (32f) or HALF (16f) channels Y (grey), A, Y (grey and alpha), B, G, R (RGB) or A, B, G, R (RGBA); PIZ as OpenEXR writes it, its Huffman heap breaking frequency ties by symbol (tinyexr with that local change, src/export/exr_writer.h, decisions 089 and 103).

entries.subject: PNG 16: the written code of each exported value
entries.formula: code = (j 65535 + 2^19 - 1) >> 20 with j = floor(clamp(v, 0, 1) 2^20) (arith::WriteUnorm), every channel as the evaluator reads it out; the files written by WriteExport equal Painter's byte for byte.

entries.subject: sRGB8 material channels (BaseColor, Specular, Emissive) in PNG 8 and 16
entries.formula: The UNORM write rule at the file's depth of the sRGB encode of the linear value: x <= 0.0031308 ? 12.92 x : fma(1.055, exp2(0.41666 log2 x), -0.055) in float32 with the recording GPU's log2 and exp2 (src/evaluator/hwmath.h; decisions 091 and 126); OpenEXR holds the linear value. Painter's own OpenEXR 32f file of each such map of export-bit-depth, encoded so, gives its PNG 8 and PNG 16 files byte for byte.

entries.notes: Not the nearest covered texel: on tier0/semantics/height-normal-bevelled-cube (Height) 12040 of the 12200 uncovered texels differ from it. Partial fit (decision 090): an 8-neighbour copy dilation (first covered neighbour: right, left, up, down, then the diagonals; x wraps, y does not) is exact on the bevelled cube's virtual normals (12200 gutter texels) and misses 32 to 44 texels per sphere normal map at the poles; a document channel's one-texel ring around each island blends across the UV seam with unidentified weights (2344 ring texels on the cube, 2152 on the sphere). Passthrough on such sets is written as no operation: Painter's r1 and r2 agree inside the islands and differ outside them at up to every uncovered texel. Owner phase1.25_pilot-wand (decision 103).
